## Summary
Provides node selector implementations used to choose a LiveKit server node from candidate routing nodes. Selectors filter unavailable nodes, optionally prefer low-load or nearby-region nodes, and choose candidates using configured sorting and selection algorithms.

## Responsibilities
- Define the NodeSelector contract and selector factory from server configuration.
- Filter nodes by availability, serving state, CPU load, system load, and region proximity.
- Select nodes using lowest-cost or power-of-two-choice algorithms.
- Sort candidates by random, normalized system load, CPU load, rooms, clients, tracks, or bandwidth rate.
- Expose selector errors and helper utilities for load and limit checks.
